name: nova_canvas_edit
description: Edit an existing image using Amazon Nova Canvas. Supports inpainting (modify a region), outpainting (extend the image), background removal, and generating image variations. Provide the source image URL and edit instructions.

image_url.description: URL of the source image to edit (presigned S3 URL or public URL)

edit_prompt.description: Instructions for how to edit the image (required for all edit types except background_removal)

edit_type.description: Type of edit to perform: 'inpainting', 'outpainting', 'background_removal', or 'variation' (optional, default = 'inpainting')
